name: epr_rank
description: Rank score of how likely the compound is to accumulate in the lung epithelial lining fluid according to the dataset from Valitalo et al 2016. Calibrated against 50K compounds from the Ersilia reference library so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.
